data.title: Bitcoin Eyes $90K Breakout After Best ETF Week Since October 2025 — Analyst Says One Level Decides It
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC) is eyeing a breakout to $90,000 after spot Bitcoin ETFs logged their best week since October 2025. But analyst Michaël van de Poppe said one level decides it all.The case for a push higher for Bitcoin’s price started with fund flows. Spot Bitcoin ETFs took in $2.39 billion last week…
